display.purpose: Primary screen titles and section headers.

components.name: Control Tile
components.css: .ds-control-tile { background: #1E2620; border: 1px solid #263028; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-icon-box { width: 34px; height: 34px; background: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-label { font-size: 11px; color: #94A696; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-value { font-size: 13px; color: #E8F2E9; font-weight: 900; }

components.name: Precision Button
components.css: .ds-btn-precision { width: 44px; height: 44px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border: 1px solid #2ECC71; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-precision:hover { background: rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: High-precision agricultural intelligence platform. The interface is designed to feel like a modern aerospace control system—crisp, deliberate, and high-density.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Action Green (#2ECC71) is reserved for high-intent interactive elements and Normal sensor states.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth is primarily communicated through background tint shifts rather than stack-based shadows.

dos: Do tint every neutral toward the brand emerald
donts: Don't use rustic or pastoral imagery
